variant.title: X-Sums Sudoku
variant.description: Each outside clue gives the sum of the first X cells seen from that side, where X is the digit in the first cell.
rule.x_sums: Each outside clue gives the sum of the first X cells seen from that side, where X is the digit in the first cell.
rule_guide.title: X-Sums Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each outside clue applies to the row or column seen from that side.
rule_guide.item_2: The first digit nearest the clue decides how many cells are included in the sum.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, if a left clue is 23 and the first digit in that row is 4, the first 4 cells from the left must sum to 23.
